layout: Each X, Y and Z rig starts with a Gearshift powered or unpowered and a +32 RPM Creative Motor on the negative face. A compatible 64 RPM Creative Motor takes over from the positive face on tick 3.
actions: Reverse the Gearshift on ticks 7 and 10. Phase 0 samples after the motor insertion and before the redstone change. Phase 1 samples immediately after the redstone change. Record Gearshift power, source facing, motor presence and theoretical RPM.
